newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Jan gold/forex reserves 11.76 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.African Jan gold/forex reserves 11.76 bln rand.

text.p: South Africa's combined gold and foreign exchange reserves surged 1.457 billion rand in January to 11.76 billion rand from December's 10.31 billion rand, when they fell 629.48 million rand, Reserve Bank figures show.
The figure was the highest since March 1996, when reserves stood at 13.992 billion rand.
A Reuters poll of economists forecast reserves would rise to 11.2 billion rand with the range 10.5 to 11.5 billion rand.
